blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: $π^4$ is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, $π^4$ achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Feed-forward models have established a powerful paradigm for reconstructing scenes directly from RGB observations ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . More recently, this paradigm has been extended beyond scene reconstruction to encompass motion recovery ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Fradlin et al., 2026 ) . A key question, however, is how well these capabilities generalize to in-the-wild observations, where scene content, camera configurations, temporal continuity, and the number of observations are unconstrained. Maintaining high-quality geometric reconstruction while robustly recovering motion from such diverse inputs remains a significant practical challenge.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward模型为直接从RGB观测中重建场景建立了强大的范例(Wang等人,2024a; 王等人著,2025a;王等人著,2025b). 最近,这一范式已经扩展到了现场重建之外,包括运动恢复(Lu等人,2026年;Fradlin等人,2026年)。 然而,一个关键问题是,这些能力在多大程度上被普遍化为零星的观测,现场内容、相机配置、时间连续性以及观测次数不受限制。 维持高质量的几何重建,同时从这种多样化的投入中大力恢复活力,这仍然是一个重大的实际挑战。

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we present 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} , a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception from RGB observations. It handles single images, unordered image collections, and videos, recovering dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D and 3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. Across the geometry benchmarks in Table 2 , 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} achieves the best overall average rank among the compared methods, while delivering competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D tracking and moving-object segmentation (Figure 2 ). Despite this broad functionality, the model employs a shared backbone across these capabilities and contains approximately 0.5B parameters in total—less than half the size of most baselines. Beyond benchmark results, Figure 1 showcases joint geometry and motion reconstruction across diverse in-the-wild observations, including aerial footage, casual handheld recordings, driving and sports scenes, and stylized content. These reconstruction and tracking results are all produced in a single forward pass per scene. This combination of accuracy, efficiency, and generality is enabled by coordinated choices in model architecture, training, and data.

blocks.en: At the architectural level, the geometry network of 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} retains the permutation-equivariant formulation of π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , treating all input views symmetrically without designating a reference view. Both the geometry and motion branches employ looped Transformer decoding ( Burzio et al., 2026 ) , which we adopt for its strong cross-benchmark performance and parameter efficiency. We choose loop weight sharing partly to reduce memory usage, freeing capacity for larger within-sequence contexts. Training stochastically samples view counts from single images, 2–24-view sets, and 32/48/64-view sets, with short contexts dominating the mixture. A sparse 3D refiner ( Kong et al., 2026 ) further enhances local surface structure and geometric detail.

blocks.en: To incorporate motion estimation without compromising reconstruction, we freeze the geometry network and train a separate geometry-conditioned motion decoder. Direct 3D tracking couples correspondence estimation with geometry, camera placement, and scene scale in the regression target. We instead keep motion prediction in image space and delegate 3D reasoning to the reconstruction branch, composing the two analytically.
blocks.zh: 为了在不损害重建的情况下纳入运动估计,我们冻结了几何网络,并训练了单独的几何条件运动解码器. 直接3D跟踪夫妇的对应估计与几何,相机放置,以及回归目标中的场景尺度. 相反,我们在图像空间中保持了运动预测,并将3D推理委托给重建分支,从分析角度将两者组成.

blocks.en: This yields a simple correspondence objective that is independent of scene scale, while placing every visible 3D track point on the reconstructed target-view surface. Geometry features also provide useful context for correspondence prediction.
blocks.zh: 这产生了一个独立于场景尺度的简单的对应目标,同时将每一个可见的3D轨道点放在重建的目标-视图表面. 几何特征也为函证预测提供了有用的上下文.

blocks.en: Complementing these architectural and modeling choices, our data construction pipeline addresses gaps in scene and camera coverage, as well as the difficulty of obtaining geometric supervision for foreground-dominated videos. We render scene-level assets from Funes ( FUNES.WORLD, n.d. ) and Sketchfab ( Sketchfab, n.d. ) , covering architectural environments and other large-scale scenes rather than isolated objects alone. Coverage-aware view selection and connected view sampling balance broad scene coverage with local cross-view matchability, while complementary natural and counterbias camera configurations expand the range of roll angles and focal lengths encountered during training. We further apply field-of-view and lens augmentation to diversify image-to-ray mappings beyond those induced by conventional pinhole or rectified imagery. For Internet videos dominated by moving foregrounds, we infer background geometry following foreground suppression and video inpainting. We retain only points corresponding to originally visible background pixels and pair the resulting pseudo-labels with the original RGB frames. GameRealm ( GameRealm Contributors, 2026 ) , developed jointly with collaborators, further provides complementary engine-native geometry and persistent point trajectories as supervision for dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: 作为这些建筑和建模选择的补充,我们的数据建设管道解决了场景和镜头覆盖的缺口,以及难以为前方主导的视频获得几何监督. 我们从Funes(FUNES.WORLD, n.d.)和Sketchfab(Sketchfab, n.d.)提供场景级资产,涵盖建筑环境和其他大规模场景,而不是单独孤立的物体. 覆盖-感知视野选择和连接视图采样平衡了广阔的场景覆盖与局部交叉视野的可匹配性,而互补的自然和反比相机配置则扩大了训练过程中遇到的滚角和焦距范围. 我们进一步采用视场和透镜放大法,使图像到射线绘图多样化,使其超出常规针孔或修正图像所引发的图像。 对于以移动前缘为主的互联网视频,我们推断背景几何在前缘压制和视频涂装之后. 我们只保留与原可见背景像素相对应的点,并将由此产生的伪标签与原RGB框架对齐. GameRealm(GameRealm Controductionors,2026年),与合作者共同开发,进一步提供辅助引擎-本土几何和持久性点轨迹作为动态场景的监督.

blocks.en: Together, these architectural, data, and training choices enable coherent joint reconstruction and tracking from thousands of images in large-scale scenes despite a maximum training context of 64 views (Figure 1 ). We further examine the architecture and training strategy of 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} through targeted ablations and qualitative comparisons, highlighting the empirical findings and practical trade-offs that motivate these choices.
blocks.zh: 这些建筑、数据和培训选择加在一起,使得在大规模场景中能够从数千幅图像中进行协调一致的联合重建和跟踪,尽管培训环境最大为64幅(图1)。 我们通过有的放矢和定性比较,进一步审查4\bm\uppi 4}的架构和培训战略,强调促使作出这些选择的经验结论和实际权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Geometry Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉几何重建

blocks.en: Classical structure-from-motion (SfM) estimates cameras and sparse structure through image matching and bundle adjustment, while multi-view stereo (MVS) reconstructs dense surfaces from calibrated views. COLMAP exemplifies this modular pipeline ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ; Schönberger et al., 2016 ) . Learned MVS methods such as MVSNet ( Yao et al., 2018 ) learn cost-volume regularization while retaining camera calibration as input. More recently, DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) predicts pairwise pointmaps without supplied cameras, and MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) combines this 3D representation with learned matching descriptors, bridging reconstruction and correspondence estimation.
blocks.zh: 经典结构-从动(SfM)通过图像匹配和捆绑调整来估计相机和稀疏结构,而多视立体(MVS)则从校准的视角重建密集的表面. COLMAP举例说明了这一模块化管道(Schönberger and Frahm,2016;Schönberger等人,2016.). 学习MVSNet等MVS方法(姚等,2018年)学习成本量规范,同时保留相机校准作为输入. 最近,DUST3R(Wang等人,2024年a)在没有提供相机的情况下预测成对点映射,MAST3R(Leroy等人,2024年)将这种3D表示法与所学的匹配描述符,桥接重建与函证估计相结合.

blocks.en: Feed-forward multi-view models increasingly estimate geometry and cameras jointly. VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) predicts cameras, depth, pointmaps, and tracks from image sets, while π 3 \pi^{3} and its released Pi3X variant ( Wang et al., 2025b ) use permutation-equivariant modeling without a privileged input reference. MapAnything ( Keetha et al., 2026 ) targets metric reconstruction with flexible geometric inputs, whereas Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) uses depth and ray prediction across arbitrary views. VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) incorporates matching supervision, and DVLT ( Burzio et al., 2026 ) reuses Transformer blocks through looped decoding. Monocular models provide complementary components: MoGe2 ( Wang et al., 2025c ) separates metric-scale prediction from relative geometry, and MoGe3 ( Kong et al., 2026 ) refines surface detail with sparse volumetric processing. Together, these methods provide complementary designs for joint camera–geometry estimation, reference-free reconstruction, metric prediction, and iterative decoding.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward多视图模型越来越多地联合估计几何和相机. VGGT(Wang et al.,2025a)预测相机,深度,点数,以及图像集的轨迹,而  3\pi^{3}及其发布的Pi3X变体(Wang et al.,2025b)则在没有特权输入参考的情况下使用permution-equivariant建模. MapAnything(Keetha等人,2026年)以灵活的几何输入量为目标进行测量重建,而Depth Anything 3(Lin等人,2025年)则使用深度和射线预测,横跨任意观点. VGGT - stage\Omega(Wang等人,2026年)结合了匹配监管,DVLT(Burzio等人,2026年)通过循环解码重用变换器块. 单体模型提供互补成分:MoGe2(Wang等人,2025c)将测量尺度的预测与相对几何区分开来,MoGe3(Kong等人,2026年)以稀疏的体积加工精炼表面细节. 这些方法共同为联合相机-几何估计、无参考重建、计量预测和迭代解码提供了互补设计。

blocks.en: 2.2 Image Correspondence and Point Tracking
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像通讯和点跟踪

blocks.en: Classical image tracking estimates motion through local appearance alignment, as in Lucas–Kanade ( Lucas and Kanade, 1981 ) . Modern optical-flow models such as RAFT ( Teed and Deng, 2020 ) learn dense two-frame correspondence, while TAPIR ( Doersch et al., 2023 ) and CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2024 ) follow queried points over videos and estimate visibility. CoWTracker ( Lai et al., 2026 ) replaces correlation-volume lookup with iterative feature warping. Optical flow and query-based tracking thus provide dense or sparse image-space correspondences, typically within ordered video sequences.
blocks.zh: 古典图像追踪通过局部外观对齐来估计运动,如Lucas–Kanade(Lucas and Kanade,1981). 现代光学流派模型如RAFT(Teed and Deng,2020年)学习密集的双帧通信,而TAPIR(Doersch等人,2023年)和CoTracker3(Karaev等人,2024年)则在视频上跟踪询问点,并估算能见度. CoWTracker(Lai等人,2026年)用迭代特征wring取代了相关量的检索. 因此,光学流动和基于查询的跟踪提供密集或稀少的图像空间通信,通常在订购的视频序列内。

blocks.en: 2.3 Dynamic Scene Reconstruction and 4D Perception
blocks.zh: 2.3 动态场景重建和4D感知

blocks.en: Dynamic scene reconstruction extends geometry estimation to scenes with moving and deforming content. Shape of Motion ( Wang et al., 2025d ) reconstructs 4D scenes from monocular videos using compact SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) motion bases and data-driven geometric and tracking priors. MonST3R ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) instead adapts pointmap reconstruction to dynamic videos by estimating per-timestep geometry without an explicit motion representation. These approaches connect scene geometry with temporal variation, but differ in how motion is represented and how reconstruction and tracking are coupled.
blocks.zh: 动态场景重建将几何估计扩展至带有移动和变形内容的场景. Motion的造型(Wang et al., 2025d)利用紧凑的SE QQ(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)运动基地和数据驱动的几何和跟踪前传,从单视视频中重建4D场景. MONST3R(Zhang等人,2025a)转而将点图重建适应动态视频,通过在没有明确运动表现的情况下估计时步几何. 这些方法将场景几何与时间变化联系起来,但在运动如何表现以及重建和跟踪如何结合方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Recent methods further extend tracking to 3D and connect it to scene reconstruction. D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and ARROW ( Fradlin et al., 2026 ) use query-based decoding to recover point positions across time and reference cameras; ARROW additionally supports unordered and multiview observations. MoSE3 ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) models dense world-space motion through per-pixel SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) transformations, while Track4World ( Lu et al., 2026 ) combines dense correspondences, geometry, and camera estimation for world-centric tracking.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法进一步将追踪延伸到3D,并将其连接到现场重建. D4RT(Zhang等人,2026年)和ARROW(Fradlin等人,2026年)使用基于查询的解码来回收跨时间和参考相机的点位置;ARROW额外支持无序和多视图观测. MoSE3(Cheng et al.,2026)通过每像素SE →(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)变换模型,而Track4World(Lu et al.,2026)结合了稠密的对应,几何,以及以世界为中心的跟踪的相机估计.

blocks.en: Moving-object segmentation provides a complementary object-level characterization of scene dynamics by identifying regions that undergo motion ( Tokmakov et al., 2019 ; Xie et al., 2026a ) . Across these directions, methods differ in their supported input configurations, output representations, and the degree to which geometry and motion are modeled jointly.
blocks.zh: 移动对象分解通过识别发生运动的区域(Tokmakov等人,2019年;Xie等人,2026a年),提供了场景动态的互补物体级特征. 在这些方向上,方法在支持的输入配置,输出表示以及几何学和运动联合建模的程度上有所不同.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} combines geometric reconstruction and motion estimation within a single feed-forward model (Figure 3 ). A shared image encoder provides features to two task-specific looped Transformer decoders. The geometry branch predicts dense pointmaps, camera poses, and metric scale; a sparse 3D refiner then improves the predicted pointmaps. Conditioned on geometry features, the motion branch predicts image-space point tracks and moving-object masks. The predicted tracks are lifted to 3D using the reconstructed target-view geometry.
blocks.zh: 4\bm\uppi 4+ 4 将几何重建与运动估计结合在一个单一的向导模型中(图 3). 一个共享的图像编码器为两个任务特定的循环变形器解码器提供了特性. 几何分支预测密度点图,相机姿势,和度量尺度;一个稀疏的3D精炼器然后改进预测的点图. 以几何特征为条件,运动分支预测图像-空间点轨迹和移动对象口罩. 利用重建的目标-视野几何法将预言的轨迹提升至3D.

blocks.en: 3.2 Shared Encoding and Looped Decoding
blocks.zh: 3.2 共享编码和循环解码

blocks.en: A shared DINOv3 encoder ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) extracts per-image patch features for both branches. We combine intermediate and late-layer encoder features, project them into the decoder feature space, and append shared learnable register tokens. We examine the choice of encoder layers in Section 6.3 .

Following Déjà View ( Burzio et al., 2026 ) , each decoder repeatedly applies the same pair of blocks, sharing their weights across its loop steps. The two decoders have independent parameters; weight sharing occurs within each branch, not between branches. blocks.en: The motion decoder starts from image tokens and adopts the same frame- and cross-view-attention block design as the geometry decoder, but with independent parameters. It follows the same looped attention structure, with additional geometry conditioning: spatial adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) conditions its attention and feed-forward sublayers on detached geometry features at the same view and patch, together with loop progress. A final within-image readout supplies the tracking and moving-object mask heads. The motion decoder uses no temporal positional embeddings.

blocks.en: The tracking head predicts correspondences from the geometry-conditioned motion features. We adapt CoWTracker’s iterative warping head ( Lai et al., 2026 ) for arbitrary-view tracking by removing its temporal positional embeddings. Outputs satisfy the query anchor 𝐔 q → q ​ ( 𝐮 ) = 𝐮 \mathbf{U}_{q\to q}(\mathbf{u})=\mathbf{u} . Sparse query tracks are obtained by sampling the dense correspondence maps.

blocks.en: 4 Training Data and Curation
blocks.zh: 4 培训数据和校正

blocks.en: 4.1 Data Sources and Mixture
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据源和混合

blocks.en: We combine public datasets with scene-level synthetic renderings, curated Internet videos, and game-based supervision to broaden scene and camera coverage and provide complementary supervision for dynamic scenes. Motion training uses point trajectories, static geometric correspondences, and real-video masks. Table 1 summarizes the data sources and sampling probabilities in the final geometry and motion training stages.
blocks.zh: 我们把公共数据集与场景层面的合成渲染,曲解的互联网视频,以及基于游戏的监督结合起来,以拓宽场景和镜头的覆盖范围,为动态场景提供互补的监督. 运动训练使用点轨迹,静态几何通信,以及真视频口罩. 表1总结了最终几何和运动训练阶段的数据来源和采样概率.

blocks.en: 4.2 Scene-Level Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 4.2 场景层面合成 数据

blocks.en: We curate approximately 10,000 scene-level 3D assets from Funes ( FUNES.WORLD, n.d. ) and Sketchfab ( Sketchfab, n.d. ) for synthetic multi-view rendering. These assets include architectural environments and other large-scale scenes, rather than only isolated objects. They support exterior observations and, where the geometry permits, interior views. Our goal is to broaden the diversity of scene layouts and camera configurations represented during training, rather than simply increase the number of rendered images.
blocks.zh: 我们从Funes(FUNES.WORLD, n.d.)和Sketchfab(Sketchfab, n.d.)中管理大约10,000个场景级3D资产,用于合成多视图渲染. 这些资产包括建筑环境和其他大规模场景,而不仅仅是孤立的物体. 它们支持外观观测,并在几何学允许的情况下支持内观. 我们的目标是扩大训练期间所代表的场景布局和相机配置的多样性,而不是简单地增加渲染图像的数量.

blocks.en: We generate candidate cameras across positions, elevations, viewing directions, and distances using surrounding-space and surface-guided proposals. Exterior views capture both overall structure and local detail; interior views require sufficient free space and renderable surfaces. Visibility and RGB-D quality checks reject invalid cameras and degenerate observations, including views dominated by open mesh backsides.
blocks.zh: 我们利用周边空间和地表制导提案,在阵地、高地、视线和距离之间生成候选摄像头。 外景既能捕捉整体结构,又能捕捉局部细节;内景需要充足的自由空间和可渲染的表面. 可见度和RGB-D质量检查拒绝无效的相机和退化的观察,包括以开放网格背面为主的视图.

blocks.en: We select views by their incremental coverage of observable surfaces, balancing surface area with spatial and orientation diversity so that large planar regions do not dominate. Depth-consistent reprojections then define a view-overlap graph, from which we sample connected view chains. Neighboring views retain reliable common geometry, while distant views may have little or no direct overlap. This design decouples global scene coverage from local cross-view connectivity: views need not all overlap a single reference or follow a smooth temporal trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对可观测表面的增量覆盖来选择观点,在表面积与空间和定向多样性之间取得平衡,这样大的浮游地区就不会占主导地位。 深度一致的再投影然后定义一个视图重叠图,我们从中取样连接到视图链. 邻里观点保留了可靠的常见几何学,而远处观点可能很少或没有直接的重叠. 这种设计将全球场景覆盖与本地交叉视图连接脱钩:视图不一定都与单一的参考内容重叠,或遵循平稳的时间轨迹.

blocks.en: We construct independent natural and counterbias view sets. Natural sets use modest camera roll and shared intrinsics, whereas counterbias sets explicitly cover broader roll angles and vary focal length across views. The two sets use independently sampled camera positions, diversifying viewpoints and occlusions rather than forming view-by-view pairs. Both sets follow the same geometric-validity principles. RGB and depth are rendered with the assigned camera parameters, followed by final quality validation and depth-based overlap computation. Figure 4 illustrates the two camera-sampling regimes on a scene-level asset.
blocks.zh: 我们搭建独立的自然和反偏见的视野。 自然套装使用适度的相机卷轴和共享的内在内容,而反斜线套装则明确涵盖较宽的卷轴角度,不同观点的焦距也各不相同. 两套镜头采用独立取样的相机姿势,使观点和隐蔽性多样化,而不是形成逐景对. 两套都遵循同样的几何有效性原则。 RGB和深度与指定的相机参数一起渲染,然后进行最终的质量验证和深度重叠计算. 图4显示在现场一级资产上的两个摄像抽样制度。

blocks.en: 4.3 Sequence-Consistent Projection Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.3 序列连续预测增强

blocks.en: Geometry training data are dominated by pinhole or rectified imagery, limiting the camera projections encountered during training. To counter this bias, we apply sequence-consistent lens and crop-and-resize augmentation. Each sequence receives an identity, barrel, blended equidistant (fisheye-like), or pincushion mapping with probability 40%, 35%, 20%, or 5%, respectively. Lens parameters and the final crop and resize are shared across frames.
blocks.zh: 几何训练数据以针孔或修正图像为主,限制了在训练中遇到的相机预测. 为了抵消这种偏差,我们采用了序列一致的镜头和作物和规模的增殖。 每个序列都得到一个身份、桶、混合等距(类似鱼眼)或针头映射,概率分别为40%、35%、20%或5%。 镜头参数和最终的裁剪和调整大小是跨帧共享的.

blocks.en: The augmentation transforms RGB and prepared geometric supervision together. For each output pixel, an inverse warp identifies a source location whose calibrated ray and camera-axis depth define the new point target, without approximating the distorted view with a new pinhole camera. Correspondence targets, visibility, and cross-view overlap are recomputed under the same mapping, while camera poses and scene scale remain unchanged. We crop to valid source-image support and resize, reducing distortion strength when necessary to satisfy a zoom limit.
blocks.zh: 扩能改造RGB,并一起准备几何监督. 对于每个输出像素,反向曲面会识别出一个源位置,其校准的射线和相机轴深度定义了新的点目标,而不会用新的针孔相机来近似扭曲的视图. 通信目标,能见度,和交叉视图重叠都是在同一映射下重算的,而相机的姿势和场景尺度保持不变. 我们裁剪到有效的源图像支持并调整大小,必要时降低扭曲强度以满足缩放限制。

blocks.en: These transforms diversify image-to-ray mappings within the observed field of view, complementing genuine camera diversity.
blocks.zh: 这些转变使观测到的视野内图像到射线绘图多样化,补充了真正的摄像机多样性。

blocks.en: 4.4 Foreground-Suppressed Supervision from Internet Videos
blocks.zh: 4.4 对互联网视频的监督

blocks.en: Figure 5: Internet-video data pipeline. Background geometry is reconstructed and filtered with moving-object masks.
blocks.zh: 图5:互联网视频数据管道. 背景几何是用移动对象口罩重建并过滤的.

blocks.en: Large moving foregrounds in Internet videos can disrupt geometry reconstruction, especially in egocentric sequences where the foreground dominates the view. These failures motivate suppressing the foreground and completing the video before geometry inference.
blocks.zh: 互联网视频中的大型移动前缘可以破坏几何重建,特别是在前缘主导景色的自我中心序列中. 这些失败刺激了对前方的压制,并在几何推断前完成视频.

blocks.en: We first mask moving foreground regions and complete the video using generative video inpainting ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Alibaba PAI, n.d. ) . An earlier geometry-only checkpoint of 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} then infers a background reconstruction from the completed video. We filter the resulting point clouds using the moving-object masks and retain only points corresponding to originally visible background pixels. This avoids placing pseudo-labels directly on inpainted content. We pair these pseudo-labels with the original RGB frames, rather than the completed video, for subsequent geometry training. Figure 5 summarizes this pipeline.
blocks.zh: (Team Wan等人,2025年;Alibaba PAI,未另作规定)。 一个较早的几何检查点, 我们使用移动对象口罩过滤产生的点云,只保留与原可见背景像素相对应的点. 这避免了将伪标签直接放置在涂抹的内容上. 我们把这些伪标签与原始的RGB帧而不是完成的视频配对,用于后续的几何训练. 图5概述了这一管道。

blocks.en: 4.5 GameRealm: Game-Based Geometry and Motion
blocks.zh: 4.5 GameRealm: 基于游戏的几何和运动

blocks.en: To broaden supervision for joint geometry and motion learning in dynamic environments, we use GameRealm ( GameRealm Contributors, 2026 ) , a game-based dataset developed jointly with collaborators. It provides engine-native geometric and motion annotations, including posed multi-view RGB-D observations for reconstruction and persistent 2D/3D point trajectories for tracking. Covering diverse scenes, viewpoints, characters, and interactions, these data complement our static scene renderings and real-video pseudo-labels with supervision for both spatial reconstruction and temporal correspondence.
blocks.zh: 为了扩大对动态环境中联合几何和运动学习的监督,我们使用GameRealm(GameRealm Controductioners,2026年),这是与合作者共同开发的基于游戏的数据集. 它提供引擎-内在几何和运动说明,包括用于重建的多视图RGB-D观测和用于跟踪的持久2D/3D点轨迹. 这些数据涵盖不同的场景、观点、人物和相互作用,它们补充了我们的静态场景渲染和真实的视频假标签,同时监督空间重建和时间对应。

blocks.en: 4.6 Training Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.6 训练议定书

blocks.en: 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} is trained progressively on 64 NVIDIA A800 GPUs, with approximately 300,000 optimizer updates across geometry-training stages. Starting from a pretrained DINOv3 encoder, early stages train the image encoder, looped decoder, and point, camera, and matching heads. Later stages introduce sparse 3D refinement and metric-scale estimation while expanding the data mixture with curated Internet videos. Successive stages inherit the preceding model weights.

blocks.en: 6 Design Choices and Empirical Observations
blocks.zh: 6 设计选择和经验观察

blocks.en: We study the architectural and training choices underlying 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} through targeted ablations and qualitative comparisons, highlighting the empirical findings and practical trade-offs that inform our final design. For loss-based ablations, we use matched model-development configurations, and percentage changes refer to relative differences in validation loss unless otherwise stated.
blocks.zh: 我们通过有的放矢的模拟和定性比较,研究4\bm\uppi4\\}的建筑和培训选择,强调指导我们最后设计的实证发现和实际权衡。 对于基于损失的拼贴,我们使用匹配的模型开发配置,除非另有说明,百分比变化是指验证损失的相对差异.

blocks.en: 6.1 Looped Transformers: Training Dynamics and Step Conditioning
blocks.zh: 6.1 循环变换器:培训动态和步骤条件

blocks.en: Figure 8: Training dynamics of looped decoders. The iteration-conditioned looped decoder achieves lower training and validation objectives than the non-looped baseline later in training.
blocks.zh: 图8:循环解码器的培训动态。 迭代条件环绕的编解码器在培训后期实现了较低的培训和验证目标,低于非制动基线.

blocks.en: Following DVLT ( Burzio et al., 2026 ) , we use a looped Transformer decoder with explicit loop-step conditioning. The looped and non-looped reconstruction models follow similar early training trajectories, but the looped model’s advantage emerges later in training and is more pronounced with step conditioning. Figure 8 shows the training and validation objectives of these decoder variants. A separate comparison within the looped architecture isolates the effect of conditioning: adding the step signal reduces local point loss by 2.8% and camera loss by 10.2% relative to the unconditioned baseline. These results support the use of step conditioning in our decoder.
blocks.zh: 跟踪 DVLT (Burzio et al., 2026),我们使用带有明确循环步调的循环变形器解码器. 循环式和非螺旋式重建模型遵循类似的早期训练轨迹,但循环式模型的优势在训练后期出现,并随着步调而更为明显. 图8显示了这些解码器变体的培训和验证目标. 环绕结构内部的单独比较隔离了调制的效果:加步信号比无条件基线减少2.8%的局部点损失和10.2%的相机损失. 这些结果支持在我们解码器中使用阶梯调节.

blocks.en: 6.2 Training View Counts and Memory Allocation
blocks.zh: 6.2 培训视图计数和记忆分配

blocks.en: Figure 9: Training memory. Peak allocated memory per full update on an A800 80GB GPU: 512 × 512 512\times 512 inputs, BF16, 16 loop steps, and activation recomputation.
blocks.zh: 图9:培训记忆。 在A800 80GB GPU上峰值分配每个完整更新的内存:512×512 512\times 512输入,BF16,16个循环步骤,以及激活重算.

blocks.en: We allocate part of the training memory budget to larger joint-view contexts, rather than using it only to pack more independent short examples. Our training recipe spans single-image inputs, short view sets of 2–24 images, and long view sets of 32, 48, or 64 images. View counts are sampled stochastically: short view sets receive most of the probability mass, with additional mass assigned to single-image inputs and the long-view buckets. This mixture combines frequent small-context updates with regular exposure to larger sets of observations.
blocks.zh: 我们把培训记忆预算的一部分用于更大的联合视角,而不是仅仅用来收集更独立的短实例。 我们的训练食谱涵盖单一图像输入、2-24集短视和32、48或64集长视。 视图计数以抽查为主:短视图集接收大部分概率质量,额外质量分配到单图像输入和长视图桶. 这种混合物结合了频繁的小文字更新和经常暴露于较大一组观测.

blocks.en: The view count refers to images from one scene or sequence, not the aggregate image count across independent examples in a batch. Including larger view sets gives the model direct training exposure to combining evidence across many observations, rather than relying exclusively on extrapolation from short inputs. This training choice complements weight sharing in the looped architecture. Figure 9 reports the measured training-memory footprint for input sets up to 64 views.
blocks.zh: 视图计数是指来自一个场景或序列的图像,而不是批次中跨独立实例的集合图像计数. 包括较大视角的组合使模型直接培训能够将许多观察中的证据结合起来,而不是完全依赖短投入的推断。 这种训练选择补充了循环架构中的权重共享. 图9报告了最多64项投入的计量培训模式足迹。

blocks.en: 6.3 Encoder Layer Selection and Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 6.3 编码层选择和微调

blocks.en: UFM ( Zhang et al., 2025c , Appendix E) shows that intermediate features from a frozen encoder can outperform its final-layer features for dense prediction. Our geometry ablations using DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) show a consistent trend. Jointly using layers 11 and 17 gives the best local point reconstruction and camera estimation among the combinations evaluated. This pair, also used in RoMa v2 ( Edstedt et al., 2025 ) , supplies the input to our multi-view decoder.
blocks.zh: UFM(Zhang et al., 2025c., 附录E)显示,冷冻编码器的中间特征可以超过其最终层特征,用于密集预测. 我们使用DINOv3(Siméoni等人,2025年)的几何分数显示一种一致的趋势。 联合使用第11层和第17层,可以对所评价的组合进行最佳局部点重建和相机估计。 这对同样在RoMa v2(Edstedt等人,2025年)中使用,为我们的多视图解码器提供输入.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning the encoder at 10 − 4 10^{-4} initially reduces the loss faster than freezing the encoder, but performs worse later in training. By contrast, fine-tuning at 10 − 5 10^{-5} reduces local point loss by 8.1% and camera loss by 4.5% relative to freezing. The comparison therefore depends on both learning rate and training duration. Our encoder remains trainable, with a lower learning rate than the decoder and prediction heads.
blocks.zh: 精细调整编码器在10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4} 起初比冻结编码器更快减少损失,但在训练后表现更差. 相比之下,在10 — 5 10 — 5} 的微调将局部点损失减少8.1%,相机损失减少4.5%。 因此,比较取决于学习率和培训期限。 我们的编码器仍然可以训练,学习率低于解码器和预测头。

blocks.en: 6.4 Output Factorization and Geometric Consistency
blocks.zh: 6.4 输出因数化和几何一致性

blocks.en: Following π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , we predict camera-local pointmaps and camera poses rather than directly regressing a global pointmap. Global point errors mix errors in local surface geometry with errors in its cross-view placement. Image evidence may constrain local surface structure even when the relative camera configuration remains uncertain. Separate local-point and camera supervision preserves this distinction, allowing local geometry to be learned without requiring global placement to be equally accurate.
blocks.zh: 我们预测相机-局部点图和相机的出现, 全局点差错将局部地表几何上的错误与其交叉视图位置上的错误混合在一起. 即使相对相机配置仍然不确定,图像证据也可能制约局部表面结构. 独立的局部点和相机监督保持了这种区别,使局部几何学得以学习,而不需要全球位置同样准确.

blocks.en: Factorizing 3D tracking into image-space correspondence prediction and geometric lifting avoids asking the motion head to independently reproduce target-view geometry and camera placement when predicting 3D endpoints or displacements. For visible tracks, lifting enforces agreement with the target geometry at the predicted correspondence by construction; independently predicted 3D positions need not satisfy this constraint.
blocks.zh: 将3D跟踪纳入图像-空间通信预测和几何提升中,避免了在预测3D端点或位移时要求运动头独立复制目标-视图几何和相机位置. 对于可见的轨迹,举起在预计的通信中通过构造执行与目标几何的协议;独立预测的3D位置不需要满足这一制约.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Motion parameterization. Top: local track–geometry close-ups; bottom: global tracks. ARROW regresses XYZ, MoSE3 predicts UV and depth, and 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} lifts UV through geometry. Independent depth can separate MoSE3 tracks from reconstructed surfaces; ours remain registered by construction.
blocks.zh: 图10:运动参数化. 顶部:本地音轨–几何特写;底部:全局音轨. ARROWs regress XYZ,MOSE3预测紫外线和深度,而 ^ 4\bm\uppi^{4}}通过几何来提升紫外线. 独立深度可以将MOSE3轨迹与重建的地表分开;我们的轨迹仍然通过建筑注册.

blocks.en: Figure 10 compares each method’s native 3D tracks with its own reconstruction. In the global views, ARROW’s directly regressed reference-frame endpoints degrade as target cameras move farther from the query view and the scene extent grows; late trajectories drift far from the corresponding scene structure. MoSE3 and 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} produce similarly coherent global trajectories, consistent with the numerical benefit of regressing image-space coordinates rather than large reference-frame XYZ values.
blocks.zh: 图10将每种方法的本地立体轨道与自己的重建轨道进行比较。 在全球观点中,ARROW 直接倒退的参考框架终点随着目标摄像头离查询视图更远,场景范围扩大而退化;后期的轨迹漂移远离相应的场景结构. MoSE3 和 π 4\bm\uppi^{4}} 产生类似一致的全局轨迹,符合反向图像空间坐标而不是大参考框架XYZ值的数值好处.

blocks.en: The local close-ups reveal a different source of error. MoSE3 lifts its UV predictions using an independently predicted tracking depth, which can place a track off the reconstructed surface even when its global trajectory looks plausible. 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} instead samples target-view geometry at the predicted correspondence, without a separate XYZ or tracking-depth prediction. Visible endpoints therefore lie on the reconstructed surface by construction, removing this independent source of track–geometry disagreement.
6.5 Geometry-Conditioned Motion
blocks.zh: 6.5 几何条件运动

blocks.en: Our geometry-conditioned motion branch is designed to reuse the spatial correspondence cues integrated by the geometry branch across views. Rather than independently learning cross-view spatial relationships, the motion branch conditions on this representation through Spatial AdaLN. In our ablation, geometry-feature conditioning reduces EPE by 7.17 px overall and 8.10 px on large-camera-baseline pairs compared with an otherwise identical model without this conditioning. These improvements show that geometry features provide useful spatial context for motion estimation, particularly for image pairs with large camera baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们的几何条件运动分支 旨在重用空间通信提示 由几何分支集成 跨视界。 与其独立学习跨视空间关系,不如通过Space AdaLN对这种代表的移动分支条件. 在我们的淡化中,几何地貌-地貌条件比一个没有这种条件的原样完全相同的模型减少了EPE 整体7.17 px和大相机-底线对8.10 px. 这些改进表明,几何特征为运动估计提供了有用的空间背景,特别是对于具有大相机基线的图像对.

blocks.en: 6.6 Camera Supervision and Gradient Routing
blocks.zh: 6.6 相机监控和渐变路线

blocks.en: Our camera ablations favor the reference-free formulation of π 3 \pi^{3} with relative pose supervision ( Wang et al., 2025b ) over regression tied to an explicitly designated reference frame, with more efficient convergence. We therefore use relative pose supervision, together with patch-matching supervision ( Wang et al., 2026 ) to support learning at initialization, when relative-pose optimization is difficult ( Wang et al., 2025b , Appendix A.4) .
blocks.zh: 我们的相机模拟器赞成使用“3\pi+3}”的无参考配方,相对地监督(Wang等人,2025年b)与明确指定的参考框架挂钩的回归,并更有效地趋同。 因此,我们采用相对姿势监督,加上补丁匹配监督(Wang et al., 2026),以支持初始化时的学习,此时相对姿势优化很难(Wang et al., 2025b, 附录A.4).

blocks.en: In an early parameter-matched comparison, patch-token readout gives lower local point and camera losses than readout from a dedicated register token. We therefore retain patch-token readout for the camera decoder.
blocks.zh: 在早期参数匹配的比较中,补丁键读出会比专用寄存符的读出减少局部点和相机损失. 因此,我们保留补丁键读取器的相机解码器。

In that section’s notation, s ⁡ ( 𝐏 ) s(\mathbf{P}) is the sequence-wide mean valid norm of predicted local points, distinct from the subsequently fitted alignment scale a a . We normalize the points while stopping the gradient through this same s ⁡ ( 𝐏 ) s(\mathbf{P}) on the camera-translation path: 𝐏 ~ = 𝐏 s ⁡ ( 𝐏 ) , 𝐭 ~ = 𝐭 sg ⁡ ( s ⁡ ( 𝐏 ) ) . \widetilde{\mathbf{P}}=\frac{\mathbf{P}}{s(\mathbf{P})},\qquad\widetilde{\mathbf{t}}=\frac{\mathbf{t}}{\operatorname{sg}\!\left(s(\mathbf{P})\right)}. The operation neither detaches the camera prediction nor removes interactions between tasks through their shared representation.

blocks.en: In the normalization ablation, detaching this gradient path reduces camera loss by 10.9%, while local point loss remains nearly unchanged, with a 0.2% increase. Our camera objective uses this gradient-routing choice.

blocks.en: 6.7 Relative-Point Supervision and Loss Weighting
blocks.zh: 6.7 相对点监督和损失

blocks.en: Supervising geometry constructed from multiple predicted quantities is established practice: VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) forms point maps from depth and camera predictions, while DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) supervises points constructed from depth and rays. We use relative-point supervision alongside local-point and camera objectives. In the loss-weight ablation, increasing the relative-point weight by an order of magnitude reduces local point loss by 5.4% and camera loss by 2.3%. Removing this term and compensating with a stronger local-point objective does not recover the same camera quality; further increasing the local-point weight does not consistently help. These comparisons guide the loss weighting in our model.

blocks.en: 6.8 Dense Prediction Heads: Practical Trade-offs
blocks.zh: 6.8 强度预测 标题:实际取舍

blocks.en: Motivated by PXDepth’s monocular-depth results, we tested a PXDepth/PixelDiT-inspired pixel-level head ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) in place of the standard convolutional head. Patch-aligned artifacts persisted in local point predictions, particularly on high-uncertainty inputs. VGGT- Ω \Omega reports related blocky artifacts for all-MLP depth decoding in uncertain regions ( Wang et al., 2026 , Section 3.1.3) .

blocks.en: We therefore retain the standard convolutional head for local point prediction. It reads the final decoder representation, without additional multi-layer feature fusion, to keep the design simple.

blocks.en: 6.9 Surface Structure Refinement with 3D Sparse Convolution
blocks.zh: 6.9 3D Sparse 组合式改进表面结构

blocks.en: Following MoGe3 ( Kong et al., 2026 ) , we include a 3D sparse-convolutional refinement stage that aggregates over geometric neighborhoods, reducing mixing between image-adjacent but depth-separated surfaces.
blocks.zh: 在MoGe3(Kong等人,2026年)之后,我们包括一个3D稀疏的精细化阶段,它聚集在几何区之上,减少图像相邻但深度分隔的表面之间的混合。

blocks.en: In qualitative zero-shot tests, we apply the pretrained MoGe3 refiner to point clouds predicted by the convolutional head, replacing its image-derived conditioning features with zeros or random noise. In the examples shown in Figure 11 , both settings yield more coherent surfaces and reduce distortions in thin structures near depth discontinuities.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Although foreground-suppressed pseudo-labeling (Section 4.4 ) reduces reliance on dynamic foreground cues, 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} can still interpret a moving foreground as stationary when the static background is weakly textured or the foreground is visually dominant. In these cases, the model confounds camera motion with object motion, yielding a reconstruction that is inconsistent with the static background. Resolving this ambiguity requires scene and motion understanding beyond local texture correspondences.
blocks.zh: 虽然前景压抑的伪标签(第4.4节)减少了对动态前景提示的依赖,但当静态背景的纹理薄弱或前景为视觉主导时,\\bm\uppi\4}\\\\\\仍然可以将移动前景解释为静止状态. 在这种情况下,模型将相机运动与物体运动混淆,产生与静态背景不一致的重建. 解决这种模糊性需要超越局部纹理通信的场景和运动理解.

blocks.en: We observe larger camera-position errors for cameras farther from the reconstruction origin than for those near it. This suggests that pose accuracy may be sensitive to the coordinate representation and the numerical scale of absolute translations. Understanding this dependence and reducing sensitivity to the choice of coordinate origin and translation magnitude remain open problems.
blocks.zh: 我们观测到相机的相机位置误差 离重建地更远 这表明,准确性对坐标表示和绝对翻译的数字尺度可能很敏感。 理解这种依赖性并降低对选择坐标源和翻译量的敏感性仍然是尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} does not consistently match the accuracy of traditional geometric optimization methods, particularly when inference sequences are longer than those seen during training. Maintaining globally consistent camera trajectories and reconstructions under such sequence-length extrapolation remains challenging. Improving long-sequence generalization and closing the accuracy gap to optimization-based methods are important directions for future work.
8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We have presented 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} , a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception from diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations. With a shared backbone and approximately 0.5B parameters, it combines dense geometry, camera pose, and metric-scale estimation with 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. By predicting image-space correspondences conditioned on geometry and lifting them into the reconstructed 3D scene, 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} unifies geometry and motion in a single forward pass.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了 4\bm\uppi\ 4\\ 4\ 4\ 4\\ 4\ 4D 场景感知的统一基础模型 从多样的,未校准的 RGB 观察。 它利用一个共享的骨干和大约0.5B参数,结合了密集的几何,相机姿势,以及公尺尺度的估算,与2D/3D点跟踪和移动-对象分化. 通过预测以几何为条件的图像空间通信,并将它们提升到重建的3D场景中,π 4\bm\uppi^{ 4\}} 统一了几何和运动的单个前传.

blocks.en: Across diverse benchmarks, 𝛑 𝟒 \bm{\uppi^{4}} achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation and competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D tracking and moving-object segmentation. It generalizes to diverse in-the-wild observations, producing coherent joint reconstructions and tracks from thousands of input images in large-scale scenes. Together with our data and training recipe and empirical studies of key design choices, these results mark a step towards unified 4D scene perception.
